title: V1 dual-host decode per-token wall-clock breakdown (--stats six phases + doorbell four-segment cross-check)
method: single-shot strata generate --stats on the 3080 host (production serve parameters, no --serve; 16-token prompt + 256 greedy decode, RDMA doorbell to the in-process cold-expert worker on Spark); two repeat runs; Spark side STRATA_PF_PROBE=1 doorbell four-segment probe (12288 pushes, full 256x48 coverage)

derived_per_layer_us.note: 48 layers; doorbell_service = read10+compute120+write20, includes RDMA both directions (worker is single-sided)

conclusions: doorbell wait 19.06ms/token (86%) = real GPU compute ~11.9ms (54%) + exposed doorbell stall ~7.2ms (33%); transfer is only 30us/layer (read10+write20), consistent with the 148-round finding that the bottleneck is the per-layer doorbell and not the transfer

of the 150us/layer doorbell service, compute is 120us - batched prefill reaches 1.75us/row, so a single-token decode over k rows should cost only 20-40us; the 120us is dominated by kernel launch/sync overhead and is compressible
PLE 1.4ms + sample 1.05ms = 2.5ms/token (11%) is an independent secondary lever

MTP quantitatively rejected: the verify-window GPU segment grows linearly with T (T x 13.4ms) while the doorbell amortisation saves only 7.2ms; at alpha=0.465, T=3 gives 24.6ms/token > the 21.96 baseline, so every T loses; measured g ~0.54~0.6 > alpha
levers_ranked: A cold-expert doorbell compute 120us->20-40us (CUDA graph / launch batching, worker-side marlin call path): saves ~3.8ms/token, 45.5 -> ~56 tok/s (+24%)
B PLE 1.43ms + sample 1.05ms host phases: ~2.5ms/token, implementation to be reviewed
C hot/cold MoE overlap by re-ordering the graph: ~1ms/token (hot marlin is only ~22us/layer and can overlap)
D inter-layer speculative prefetch: depends on the previous layer's output, not feasible (numerical correctness), rejected
production_restore: Spark engine restarted without the probe variable -> 3080 serve restarted -> both legs health ok -> router E2E 200 (chatcmpl-c59f421a463e4e14825774a6)
caveats: the STRATA_PF_PROBE pb vector grew unbounded (~6GB/day at 45tok/s); never leave it on in production - it was removed by the restart in this round
the 11.9ms GPU compute figure is estimated by subtraction (ring_wait - doorbell_service) and includes flag detection latency
